summary: Executed preview auth regression for fixed manager PIN flow across backend + frontend. Core login/refresh/trusted-device flows passed; one CORS preflight requirement failed for production Origin compatibility.

critical.issue: Preflight response returns access-control-allow-origin=* and omits access-control-allow-credentials for Origin=https://car-repair-sys.emergent.host; this breaks credentialed cross-origin expectation.

action_items: Fix preview ingress/CORS behavior so preflight for https://car-repair-sys.emergent.host returns explicit Access-Control-Allow-Origin (not *) and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.
Verify startup fail-closed for missing JWT secret at boot (code review indicates JWT secret guard is runtime-invoked in token ops, not explicitly validated during startup).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exceeds 700 lines and aggregates many concerns (routing, middleware, persistence helpers), increasing auth/security regression risk.
Startup hook validates manager PIN configuration, but no explicit startup-time JWT_SECRET validation is present; current guard appears deferred to token creation/decode usage.
seed_data_creation: Temporary test user entry in uploads/users.json for "مستخدم اختبار" is created only if missing and restored in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on preview URL only. Login page shows fixed manager identity, 6-digit PIN field, no Google UI, wrong PIN rejected, correct PIN redirects to / and stores session/auth_token/trusted_device with admin role. Auth regressions iter256 and iter255 pass. Remaining failure is CORS preflight behavior for production Origin.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: OPTIONS /api/auth/login with Origin=https://car-repair-sys.emergent.host and Access-Control-Request-Method=POST returns 204 but with Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* and no Access-Control-Allow-Credentials header. Likely cause is preview edge/proxy CORS layer overriding intended app-level explicit-origin+credentials policy. Mitigation: enforce explicit origin echo and credentials=true at ingress/edge for allowed origins; avoid wildcard when credentials are required.
